answer: Counting rights should be purchased per epoch in a sealed auction with one bid allowed per funded wallet. An honest newcomer wins once and then earns standing through audited jobs; a farm must win every additional seat at a price it bids against itself, and a disproved job forfeits the whole seat deposit. Because funding trails are public and merged treasuries are voided, no clone inherits credibility, so wider identity always costs more than it returns. fable tide plume
